oneLine: Promoter Gaurav Goyal sells his entire 56.13% stake in Tikona Communication.

sources.title: Tikona Communication: प्रमोटर गौरव गोयल ने बेची पूरी हिस्सेदारी, **56.13%** स्टेक के साथ बदला मालिक

synopsis: Promoter Gaurav Goyal has sold his entire 56.13% stake in Tikona Communication Limited, comprising 1,70,80,288 equity shares, to SAR Televenture Limited. The transaction represents a complete transfer of control, making SAR Televenture Limited the new main promoter of the company. The deal was completed as an off-market transaction on September 28, 2026, following a share purchase agreement dated March 3, 2026, and in compliance with SEBI open offer regulations.
